Fellow racer Glenn Irwin called Mr Godfrey - who rode in the National Superstock 1000 class - the "King of the Dutch Superbike race at Assen", referring to the track in the Netherlands that annually hosts British Superbike races. Superbike is a type of motorcycle racing in which the bikes used are derived from standard production models, and differ only slightly from sports bikes seen on the roads.
pair.prefix: Ben Godfrey, 25, fell from his bike after a crash with another rider during the No Limits Trackdays event at the Leicestershire circuit on Sunday. Organisers said: "Tragically he suffered serious injuries and despite immediate medical assistance trackside, he succumbed to his injuries." Mark Neate, director of No Limits Trackdays, said: "Ben really was a fantastic young man." Mr Neate said Mr Godfrey, from Long Eaton in Derbyshire, was "friends with so many people in the paddock".
